name: What are the common signs that I need new windows?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs that I need new windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common indicators for window replacement include drafts near closed windows, difficulty opening or closing them, visible damage like cracks or rot, condensation between glass panes, or a noticeable increase in your energy bills. Older single-pane windows are particularly inefficient. Replacing them can improve your home's comfort, reduce noise from outside, and enhance curb appeal. Consider a professional assessment if you experience any of these issues to determine the best course of action for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drafts, condensation between panes, difficulty operating, or rising energy bills are common signs you may need new windows.
